description: Rig and animate an already succeeded humanoid-riggable generated model, or humanoid models inside an asset pack. For common game-ready bundles, call list_model_animation_sets and pass its stable animation_set_id directly; no motion_prompt is required for that path. For custom motion selection, use list_model_animation_options and pass a motion_prompt with optional exact action IDs. Do not combine animation_set_id with animation_action_ids. This is derivative post-processing on an existing Mint chat-backed asset. Follow returned batch/clip IDs with get_model_animation, wait_for_model_animation, and animation artifact tools.

animation_action_ids.description: Optional exact catalog action IDs for a custom motion_prompt. Do not combine with animation_set_id.

animation_set_id.description: Stable curated set ID returned by list_model_animation_sets. Do not combine with animation_action_ids.

motion_prompt.description: Required for a custom animation request; optional when animation_set_id is provided.
